title: Corsi-VR & Deary-Liewald VR (DLRTT-VR): Immersive Virtual Reality Assessments of Visuospatial Working Memory and Psychomotor Reaction Time (Unity Project)
description:
Open-source Unity 2021.3 LTS project for the Corsi Block Test in Virtual Reality (Corsi-VR) and the Deary-Liewald Reaction Time Task in Virtual Reality (DLRTT-VR). Includes 12 hardware-tailored scenes and automated build pipelines for Windows 64-bit PC VR (Varjo Aero / XR-3 / VR-3 with 200 Hz eye tracking and pupillometry, HTC VIVE Pro Eye with 120 Hz SRanipal eye tracking and pupillometry, and Universal OpenXR PC VR) and Standalone Android OpenXR (HTC VIVE Focus Vision with 120 Hz eye tracking and pupillometry via XR_HTC_eye_tracker, Meta Quest Pro with eye tracking via XR_EXT_eye_gaze_interaction, and Universal Standalone OpenXR for Meta Quest 2/3/3S/Pro and VIVE Focus Vision/3).

Source code is licensed under the MIT License. Spoken audio instructions, demonstration videos, and on-screen instruction texts are licensed under CC BY 4.0. Third-party SDKs and packages retain their respective licences (see NOTICE.md and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
